binary_006516: Bit masks $01..$80 indexed by the low byte of a flag word.
code_0064CC: Set or clear an event flag. In: A = flag word (low byte = bit number 0-7, bits 8-14 = byte index into $1A5E, bit 15 set = set the bit, clear = clear it). Preserves X.
code_0064F8: Test an event flag. In: A = flag word. Out: carry set when the flag bit is set, clear otherwise. Preserves X.
code_00651E: Look up an inventory/progress entry. In: A (8-bit) = entry number (1-based). Out: carry set and A preserved when the value bits (0-6) are zero; carry clear and A = the whole $1B1E byte when they are not.
code_0065A7: Clear the collision footprint of the actor at X: for every tile under its box (widths $10/$12) the low byte of the entry in the collision buffer $7F8000 is zeroed. Uses lib_027462 to turn the position into a buffer offset. Counterpart of Cop15_BlockOwnTiles, which ORs $F0 into the same entries.
code_006617: Convert a slot number to a slot address. In: A (8-bit) = slot number. Out: Y = $0800 + number * $40.
code_006628: Tile number to pixel coordinate: A = A * 16.
code_00662D: Register the actor X in the table $7F0483 at index A (word entries). Used by Cop14_JumpIfSwitchSet and Cop3B_JumpIfSwitchSetData. Preserves A and X.
code_00663A: Spawn: take a free slot, link it AFTER the actor X, then initialise it (code_0066A3). Out: Y = new slot, carry set when no slot is free.
code_006662: Spawn: take a free slot, link it BEFORE the actor X, then initialise it (code_0066A3). Out: Y = new slot, carry set when no slot is free.
code_00668A: Pop a free slot from the stack at $4A. Out: Y = slot, carry clear; or carry set (Y = $06AA, a scratch slot) when the stack is empty.
code_0066A3: Initialise a new actor Y from the caller X: copy $3C bytes (MVN), set $16 bit $2000 and clear bit $0010, zero $1A, $30 and $14.
code_list_005638: Handler words for command ids 00-3C, indexed id*2. Ids 0E, 0F, 2C and 2D are #$0000 (undefined).
code_list_005738: Handler words for command ids 80-B2 (id = $80 + index).
cop_junk: Filler words (#$0000 or #$FFFF) that cover command ids 3D-7F so that code_list_005738 starts at id 80 (code_list_005638 + $100). No handler.
loc_0064B5: Skip 5 operand bytes (falls through the INC chain to loc_0064BF).
loc_0064BB: Skip 2 operand bytes (a not-taken jump with one &Code operand).
loc_0064BF: Continue at the script pointer: A = $38.
loc_0064C1: A = new script pointer (jump target or $38). Replaces the return address on the stack and returns with RTI.
loc_0064C4: Save $38 as the actor's resume pointer ($18,X), then yield.
loc_0064C9: Yield: PLA PLA RTL back to the actor loop. The script resumes next time from $18,X/$36,X.
native_mode_cop_00561E: Native-mode COP vector. In: X = actor slot (copied to Y), stack = return address of the COP instruction. Sets $3A (script bank) and $38 (script pointer at the command id), reads the id, advances $38 and dispatches through code_list_005638,X.
